facts.function: mechanism allowing a seat to recline
facts.end_use: furniture seating (recliner chairs/sofas), not motor vehicle

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9401 seats and parts thereof
Chapter 94 note 1(d) excludes parts of general use of base metal, but a recliner mechanism is specific to seats; HQ 966201 treated seat adjusters as parts of seats rather than 8302

rejected_alternatives.reason: furniture mountings; rulings on seat adjusters put them in heading 9401 as parts
for motor vehicle seats; not stated
medical and barber chairs; not stated

classification.rationale: Metal recliner mechanisms are parts of seats of heading 9401; 966201 (seat adjuster for automobiles) supports treating such mechanisms as seat parts, here the non-vehicle Other line.
